description:
Implement the spec in .openspec/specs/memory-consolidation/spec.md. Owner's direction 2026-11-06, after reviewing Anthropic's 'The components of agent memory' (https://www.anthropic.com/research/components-of-agent-memory): the verified memory gate already handles the trust half of agent memory; this order builds the use half. Pipeline for this order is sdlc-default (software domain, full reviewer set), selected by the run workflow. The run touches anvil/brain.py (proposal and entry formats, the promotion gate, check-brain), anvil/runner.py (per station packet selection, the consolidation post check, the report's memory field set), anvil/config.py (the memory_consolidation flag), the station registry (the new consolidator station and its prompt), the sdlc-default and greenfield pipeline definitions, and tests. Standard library only.

STAGING: this order is filed and staged only. Execution starts on the owner's word. If the deterministic preflight order (issue 28) has executed and merged before this run starts, this order's delta must pass the preflight it adds; if it has not, proceed without it and say so in the run evidence.

Build, per the spec requirements:

R1, scoped learnings: the proposal format gains three optional fields (Stations, Specs, Keywords) and promoted entries record them on a Scope line. Entries with no scope are global and match every context, exactly as today. Matching is conjunctive across the fields an entry carries and disjunctive inside one field.

R2, selective retrieval: packet assembly computes the Verified learnings section per station from the selection context (station id, the spec slug the work order declares, keyword matches against the work order title and description). Only verified, non demoted entries are candidates; selection can only narrow, never widen. An empty selection means no section, as with an empty store today. The existing budget trim order is unchanged and runs after selection. Deterministic, standard library only, no embeddings and no model call in selection.

R3, end of run consolidation: a new agent station, consolidator, appended after observer in sdlc-default and greenfield, gated by the project config flag memory_consolidation (default off; when off the step records not enabled and costs no model call). When on, its packet carries the run verdict and decision summary, the counted reviews with findings, the loopback count, the observer output when present, the current verified learnings and the waiting inbox claims. Its output contract allows it to create proposal files in brain/inbox/ only, each naming the current run as Source-Run, citing an artifact of the current run, and carrying a Quote (R4); it proposes reusable rules and facts, successes as well as failures, never one off incident detail. A deterministic post check in the runner records any write outside brain/inbox/ as a boundary violation and marks the step failed, records malformed proposals (unparseable, wrong source run, missing artifact, no Quote) by name and reason, and deletes and records proposals that duplicate an existing verified claim or an earlier proposal of the same pass (whitespace and case normalized comparison). The consolidator never promotes and never demotes.

R4, claim support quotes: a proposal may carry a Quote, a literal excerpt of its cited artifact. When present, promotion requires the excerpt to appear in the artifact text after whitespace normalization on both sides; a missing quote match or a non text artifact refuses promotion with that reason and changes nothing. Promoted entries record a Quote line; check-brain re-verifies quotes and fails naming the entry when one no longer appears. Entries and proposals without a quote behave exactly as today.

R5, reporting: report.json gains a memory field set (verified ids at run start, selected ids per station, consolidation outcome with proposals written, duplicates rejected, malformed proposals with reasons, boundary violation paths), distinct from the checks result and from review verdicts.

Guardrails: Python standard library only, no new dependency. Frozen surfaces: the verified-memory scenarios S1 to S7 and the gate's behavior for proposals carrying none of the new optional fields, the review parse contract and parse_review semantics, the canonical review contract wording, the reviewer prompts and their Output Format sections, the review producer mechanisms, and the checks gate behavior. Backward compatibility is tested, not assumed (spec S10): brain stores written before this change, including this repo's own brain, pass check-brain and produce identical Verified learnings sections when no new fields are present and the flag is off. Do not create, modify, or delete any file under tests/ that exists at the base ref (the checks gate protects base ref test files); new tests are added as new files or appended through the line's normal flow. No em dash or en dash character in any produced file. The reviewer writes its review to the authoritative review file named in its packet; prose outside that file is not a review. Nothing in this order publishes anything.

Named follow-on work, not part of this order: graduation of repeated learnings into specs, station prompts or deterministic checks, and a longitudinal memory ablation benchmark (memory off, all learnings, selected learnings) over repeated work orders.

GitHub issue: https://github.com/arananet/anvil-factory/issues/33
title: Memory consolidation and selective retrieval: scoped learnings, an end of run consolidation pass, and claim support quotes for the memory gate
